instruction: Query the OQMD database for Al-O compounds with volume between 8 and 12 A^3/atom (element_set=Al,O AND volume>8 AND volume<12), save the count and first result to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_14.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
